title: Oila
hook_voice: Lesson sixteen. Mother, father, brother, sister.

example.en: This is my sister. She is a student.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga o'n yettinchi dars: qayerdansiz?
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 16-dars: inglizcha oila a'zolari.

This is my mother — Bu mening onam
This is my father — Bu mening otam
This is my brother — Bu mening akam / ukam

brother — aka ham, uka ham; sister — opa ham, singil ham: This is my sister — Bu mening opam / singlim.
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 17-dars: Qayerdansiz?
